protocol.selection: DEVELOPMENT_AND_VALIDATION_ONLY; frozen before final test; no parameter optimization
protocol.walk_forward: Three non-overlapping validation/test subsegments; fixed parameters; no final-test reselection
protocol.source: BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT; virtual SHORT; no funding/borrow modeled; not futures

source.limitation: Chronological holdout within this frozen experiment, not a pristine project-wide holdout. Requires new forward validation.

selection.reason: No candidate passed the predeclared development/validation criteria. Fixed Donchian 15m is an experimental execution candidate, not a profitable winner.
